cliente1988.receiving_setup: Getnet account with Pix receipt enabled in the app

connectivity_steps: Check the Wi-Fi and 4G icons on your Get Smart.
Reconnect Wi-Fi or confirm the 4G chip has a data plan.
Use the original charger and leave the terminal closed.
If it stays offline, call Getnet at 4002-4000 with serial GT-1988-SMART.
decline_steps: Read the decline text on your Get Smart screen and retry the sale once.
Ask the customer to use another card or Pix.
If declines continue, call Getnet at 4002-4000 with serial GT-1988-SMART.
